feedback.text: Loving the real-time Carbon Passport! Could we add college bus route tracking to log Scope 3 commute savings?
feedback.adminReply: Great idea! We are piloting GPS tracking on 6 Kanakapura road college buses in phase 2.

feedback.text: The solar generation overlay in the 3D twin is impressive. Faculty suggest scheduling lab batches during peak solar hours (11:00 - 14:00).
feedback.adminReply: Implemented in the Auto-Optimizer timetable recommendation engine!
